title: Quick check: Managing Complex State

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Managing Complex State”?
options: The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
State transition models should have clear ownership and avoid duplicated or contradictory state.
questions.answer_key: State transition models should have clear ownership and avoid duplicated or contradictory state.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Managing Complex State: State transition models should have clear ownership and avoid duplicated or contradictory state.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying State transition models?
options: Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Choose one source of truth and avoid storing values that can be computed from existing state.
Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
questions.answer_key: Choose one source of truth and avoid storing values that can be computed from existing state.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Managing Complex State: Choose one source of truth and avoid storing values that can be computed from existing state.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “Managing Complex State” complete?
options: Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Managing Complex State: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
